start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
participant db
user -> app: login
app -> db: query
db --> app: rows
app --> user: ok
@enduml

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
participant db
user -> app: login
db --> app: rows
app -> db: query
app --> user: ok
@enduml

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — db → app":
  - heading "Relation — db → app" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Synchronous"
    - option "Asynchronous"
    - option "Return" [selected]
    - option "Create"
    - option "Lost"
    - option "Found"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "user"
    - option "app"
    - option "db" [selected]
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "user"
    - option "app" [selected]
    - option "db"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label": rows
  - button "Invert direction"
  - group "Message order":
    - text: Message order
    - button "Move earlier"
    - button "Move later"
  - paragraph: Drag a message line up or down to reorder it, or press Delete to remove it.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
